text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick ping 1: compact manager cheat-sheet for Week 1 + a fillable 30/60/90. Wanted to share for review: https://redwood.ok/onboard-cheats. Short version below.

Sam (People Ops): Pre-day: confirm hardware + accessories, submit IT ticket, assign buddy, send intro email.

Sam (People Ops): Day1 AM: org orientation (30m), manager 1:1 (30m) - role purpose + top priorities, team intros (30m). Day1 PM: accounts + tooling, security brief.

Sam (People Ops): Day2: product & architecture overview; Day3: local dev + test runner + starter PR assigned; Day4: cross-team intros + draft 30/60/90; Day5: ship or pair on small change + feedback.

Mia (Eng Manager): Love the compactness. Please add: Day1 1:1 prompts (communication norms, success signals) and a "first-commit" rubric (tests, lint, 1 reviewer).

Alex (DevEx): I'll link quick local dev guide and mark starter issues with "starter-pr" so reviewers spot them. Also suggest a 1.5h shadow slot on Day5 for first deploy.

Raj (IT): Managers: open IT provisioning form as soon as offer accepted: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. Requests before 10:00 PST on start day get same-day provisioning. Include manager approval for VPN/KMS.

Kaya (new-hire): Thanks! Quick q: how big should the Day3 PR be?

Mia (Eng Manager): Keep it tiny and meaningful: docs fix, one test, or small bug (1-3 files). We'll pair if you want.

Sam (People Ops): Great feedback 1. I'll update the one-pager and the editable 30/60/90 template and push by EOD. Please comment in the doc for role-specific changes. :sparkles:
